title: Advanced RAG and Retrieval Systems
description: Move beyond basic vector search with hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata, and production indexing.
learningOutcomes: Design retrieval around measurable failure modes
Combine lexical semantic and structured retrieval
Operate evolving indexes with citations and access controls

lessons.title: Hybrid Retrieval and Query Rewriting
lessons.description: Blend lexical and semantic signals and reshape difficult queries.

lessons.title: Reranking and Context Selection
lessons.description: Spend model budget on the passages most likely to support an answer.

lessons.title: Metadata, Graphs, and Structured Retrieval
lessons.description: Use filters, relationships, and database queries alongside vector search.

lessons.title: Indexing Pipelines and Freshness
lessons.description: Build incremental, idempotent ingestion with deletion and version handling.

lessons.title: Access Control, Citations, and Production Evals
lessons.description: Keep retrieved evidence authorized, attributable, and continuously evaluated.
